en: Piers
Champion {player}, every League you have won is stamped. The final of the Laurel Circuit begins now.
You will face each Champion in turn, at level {result}, with no rest between. Your bag is your own. Champions, step forward!
Cynthia
Sinnoh's Champion opens the final. I'll give you nothing less than everything.
{rival}
Kanto's turn. I've been training since the day you took my title. Let's settle it!
Lance
Johto's dragons answer to me. Let's see if they answer to you.
Wallace
Hoenn's Champion, at your service. Shall we make this the most beautiful battle of the day?
Iris
Unova's Champion is up! My dragons and I won't hold back, not even a little.
Diantha
Kalos closes the final. Let's give the hall an ending it will remember.
Piers
The final is won! Champion of every League you have crowned, and now the Laurel Champion.
Your team will stand on the circuit's plinth in the Laurel Gallery. Circuits won: {result}.
The next circuit will meet you five levels higher. Rest well, Laurel Champion.
Piers
The final ends here for today. Your circuit stands, and the Champions will wait for you to try again.
The final opens once every League you have won is stamped. Stamps so far: {result}.
This is the Laurel Court, where the Laurel Circuit's final is fought. Begin a circuit at the Laurel Gallery's desk.
